body:
Codex (m3) read this issue for work and stopped before a claim. No branch and no PR exist for it.

The defect does not reproduce on upstream/main `76186e5c4`, and it is not fixed there. The code that shows it is not on GitHub.

- On main, `a_four_turn_thread_flank_meshes_at_full_fidelity_in_a_bounded_count` uses the old reader. The issue says that the pin passes there. A pinning test cannot fail on main.
- On main, `machining_mesh` refuses a mesh that is not watertight. The flank fixture is one face in an `OPEN_SHELL`. The 391338 facets and the note `STEP sheet #418` come from a sheet path that main does not have.
- The pushed branch `issue/917-solidcore-step` (`776ba8b76`) does not have that path. It replaces the test with `a_four_turn_thread_flank_sheet_is_refused_by_name`.
- A comment on #917 (2026-11-19T21:41Z) says that part B is held in a local worktree and is not pushed.

Findings about the two options, read from solidcore-tess at the pinned rev `2016386`:

- `solidcore_tess::plan(b, tolerance, size)` takes `MeshTolerance { chord, angle }` only. `mesh(b, spec, size, size_at)` takes one scalar size field. No public call takes a step for each direction. Option 2 needs a new API in `NeoTech/solidcore`.
- Options 1 and 2 are changes in `NeoTech/solidcore`, and then a move of the pin in `crates/kernel/Cargo.toml`. An issue worker in this repository cannot do them.
- A third option exists in our seam. All fields of `TessPlan` and `FacePlan` are public (`uv`, `fixed`, `triangles`). The seam can replace the interior division of one face, keep the `fixed` boundary nodes, and keep the new division only if `mesh_deviation::measure_within` proves it within the tolerance. This is a new division algorithm (`effort:max`). It needs the sheet path of part B for its pin.

Suggestion: work this issue on a branch stacked on the part B PR of #917, after that PR is pushed. The maintainer decides.
